title: Capstone: Design Under CAP
description:
**SITUATION:**

You are still on the **Fleetline** dispatch team.

**What the dispatch service is.** Dispatch is Fleetline's backend for trips. It is not the map, not payments, and not the driver chat. It is the service that **owns trip state**: who requested the ride, which driver was matched, and what step the trip is on right now.

Incident tabletop: "West is dark to East for 90 seconds." Simulate it. Show what riders and drivers experience for match vs map.

**YOUR TASK:**

Implement Lab 5.4 (`TODO(5.4)`).

One scenario harness: partition → load → heal → checks.

Pass: no double match; soft reads available; post-heal convergence; document which ops returned errors on purpose.

**SPEC:**

- Integrates 5.1–5.3
- No double-assign under partition
- Soft AP + reconcile on heal
- Closes CAP / PACELC

> **Note:** Graded Submit for this lab is not live yet. Use **Run** in the editor when verify commands exist; otherwise read the brief and explore the starter. The harness lands next.

hints: Pass: no double match; soft reads available; post-heal convergence.
Document intentional errors on the minority.
Fail if you assign on both sides to fake availability.
Tabletop the UX on each side.
problemStatement.overview: City-split scenario: CP match, AP map, sane heal.
problemStatement.brief: Run partition → load → heal with the checks from 5.1–5.3.
